Ryan is still on probation (started 12 May; probation ends 12 November) and already has one UA from 18 August. A second UA during probation triggers the automatic termination letter with one week’s notice, generated by payroll and sent the same day.

The note does not affect payroll or probation, but it creates an accurate record of the mitigating circumstances. Once the UA is submitted, the payroll consequence follows automatically; acting honestly and in line with the code definitions is the right thing to do.
